prioritized_defects.description: Encrypted multicast join/leave notification handling is not modeled: the join/leave notification actions bypass the encryption decision and decryption step, so the required 'Message is decrypted only if Message is encrypted' behavior is not applied to the multicast group notification scenario.
prioritized_defects.evidence: Use Case 1 requires: 'Message is encrypted or Message is not encrypted', 'An agent sends notify to join/leave multicast group', and 'Message is decrypted only if Message is encrypted.' The diagram routes N2 -> N12/N13 -> N14/N15 -> N16 with no connection from the notification path through N3 (Encrypt message?) or N7 (Provide message decryption techniques).
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Route join/leave notification through the same encryption decision and conditional decryption handling used for other secured communications, so encrypted notifications are decrypted before completion and non-encrypted notifications bypass decryption.
Connect all diagram nodes to the main workflow.

prioritized_defects.description: The multicast receive behavior is only partially represented: the diagram shows send and receive actions, but the receive action is not integrated as a clear continuation of the multicast communication path under the encryption/decryption branch, leaving the required multicast receive scenario under-modeled.
prioritized_defects.evidence: Use Case 3 requires an agent sends multicast message, other agents in the group receive message, and message is decrypted only if encrypted. The current flow is N2 -> N8 -> N3 -> N4/N6 -> N7 -> N16, but the multicast receive node N9 is detached from the decryption sequence and goes directly to the final node via E20.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Connect the multicast branch so that receipt by group members occurs after the encrypted/not-encrypted handling, and ensure the receive node is part of the same execution path as the multicast send/decrypt flow.

final_recommendation: Prioritize D1 first because it blocks a required encryption/decryption behavior on a main notification path, then address the structural unreachable nodes in D-STRUCT-003, and finally repair D2 to complete the multicast receive flow.
